en.subtitle: INTERIOR STUDIO
en.select_hint: Drag furniture to move it. Tap to edit.
en.place_hint: Drag onto the plan or tap to place.
en.move_hint: Tap a new position on the plan.
en.rotate_hint: Use the arrows to rotate in 45° steps.
en.synced_hint: Plan and 3D overview stay in sync.
en.save_failed: Could not verify the save. Try again.
en.reset_body: Other floor plans are kept. You can undo this change.
en.sample_body: The current plan changes. Undo restores your previous layout.
en.load_body: All three floor plans will be replaced by the saved project.
en.floor_hint: Select a space. Make it yours.
en.tutorial_body:
1  Choose a floor plan.
2  Drag furniture onto the plan.
3  Drag to move; tap to rotate.
4  Save your layout.

ko.subtitle: 인테리어 스튜디오

ko.tutorial_body:
1  평면도를 선택하세요.
2  가구를 평면도로 끌어 배치하세요.
3  끌어서 이동하고, 눌러 회전하세요.
4  완성한 배치를 저장하세요.
